Environment and

Expenditure)
column7:
Reduction in provision
of ` 37.00 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
`5.00 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
`5.00 lakh and
surrender of ` 37.00
lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
payment of medical
expenditure of
staff/officers. Decrease
by re-appropriation was
attributed to to amount
more than need in
contract services.
Surrender was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
maintenance and fuels
of vans, travelling
ependitures and
medical charges.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(August 2023).
